issue.body:
This commit changes `SyntheticIdField` to be an indexed field but with an empty `TokenStream` to ensure that there's minimal work done while indexing synthetic _id fields. The reason for the change is that Lucene ensures that the schema is consistent across all the segments and new documents, and before we used to modify the `_id` `FieldInfo` at read time to ensure that the field is considered as indexed to allow update/deletes, but once a new document is added, it will have `IndexOptions.NONE` and Lucene would throw an exception.

This change also ensures merges are handled correctly. Since Lucene relies on PerFieldPostingFormat to fetch the format (ignoring the segment info codec), the new codec ensures the correct format is resolved.

In addition to such changes, there's some small code reorganization and simplification.

issue.body:
Today if indexing a document fails then we log it at `DEBUG` in the following places regardless of the exception type:

https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/49858d1795ffc9b508a0cc5e112d7b1b611120e3/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/action/bulk/TransportShardBulkAction.java#L561-L576

https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/b09f1d72f40c78667f8128c5ef9e451fbe2b7b0e/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/index/shard/IndexingFailuresDebugListener.java#L40-L51

Most such exceptions will be client errors with a 4xx code, for instance documents that don't match the defined mappings, but some may be server errors with a 5xx code that indicate a bug. We log top-level 5xx responses at `WARN` to make sure we detect such bugs quickly:

https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/4b7de2fa30f540e70dd6a69c9cc6adf1d19e220d/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/rest/RestResponse.java#L136-L140

Should we apply the same reasoning to document-level failures and report 5xx errors at `WARN` there too?

Relates https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/140492: this NPE should be visible as a warning IMO but today it is not by default.

SyntheticIdField uses an empty token stream with no attributes. 
Override #end() to prevent NPE from attribute access in the base implementation.

Closes #140492
